Actions.Text:
#!/bin/bash

# 1. Get the full path from your KM variable
# We ensure the tilde (~) is expanded to the full path
full_path="${KMVAR_Local_BackupFilepath/#\~/$HOME}"

# 2. Extract the parent directory (one level up)
backup_dir=$(dirname "$full_path")

# 3. Calculate the cutoff date (YYYYMMDD)
# Subtracts the number of days specified in your KM variable
retention_days="$KMVAR_Local_RetentionDays"
cutoff_date=$(date -v-"${retention_days}"d +%Y%m%d)

# 4. Loop through and delete old folders
for folder in "$backup_dir"/*; do
    # Only act if it is a directory
    if [ -d "$folder" ]; then
        folder_name=$(basename "$folder")
        
        # Take the first 8 characters of the folder name
        folder_date=${folder_name:0:8}
        
        # Check: Does the name start with 8 digits AND is that date < the cutoff?
        if [[ "$folder_date" =~ ^[0-9]{8}$ ]] && [ "$folder_date" -lt "$cutoff_date" ]; then
            echo "Deleting old backup: $folder_name"
            rm -rf "$folder"
        fi
    fi
done
